verdict.rationale: An official CLI (Wally) exists and documentation says the same CLI runs a small local model offline and that one command points a tool at a model and starts it, which implies the CLI fetches and runs models. However, the only documented download and progress mechanics belong to the Swift SDK, not the CLI, and nothing shows searching, listing or deleting models from the command line. missing for 10: CLI model search/browse command, explicit CLI download command with progress, CLI list/remove/manage commands, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI model management.
